notes: Two self-contained vertical story shorts. Original perceptron experiment only; no reruns. Existing owner-supplied moving footage is prioritized. Clean English-label picture, independent Chinese audio and external EN/ZH subtitles. No source/chapter badges. Medical claims describe the single published 2021 case; illustrative footage never claims to show the patient's visual experience.

title.zh: 一九五七年的模型，怎么跑赢大模型？
title.en: How did a 1957 model win this race?

lines.zh: 我们带上 Claude Fable 5.1 和 GPT-6-Astra，穿越到一九五七年，来场模型速度大比拼！
lines.en: Let’s take Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT-6-Astra back to 1957 for an AI speed race!

lines.zh: 同一张七，四位选手一起认。X 一开始就答完了。
lines.en: Four programs get the same seven. X finishes almost instantly.

lines.zh: 每张只要{x_us}微秒。{test_n_zh}张测试图，全都答对。
lines.en: Just {x_us} microseconds per picture. All {test_n_en} test pictures correct.

lines.zh: 比 Claude Fable 5.1 快{claude_million_zh}万倍，比 GPT-6-Astra 快{astra_ten_million_zh}万倍！
lines.en: {claude_million_en} million times faster than Claude Fable 5.1, and {astra_ten_million_en} million times faster than GPT-6-Astra!

lines.zh: 这就是感知机。一九五七年的思路，只有{pixel_n_zh}个分数。
lines.en: Meet the perceptron: a 1957 idea, using just {pixel_n} points.

lines.zh: 把黑格子的分数加起来，够了就回答“是”。
lines.en: Add the black squares’ points. Enough points means yes.

lines.zh: {train_n_zh}张例子，让它把这些分数一点点调好。
lines.en: It learned from {train_n} examples, adjusting those points along the way.

lines.zh: 专项任务跑得快，不代表整体能力更强。
lines.en: Winning this specialized speed test doesn’t make it smarter overall.

lines.zh: 格子纸，几支笔，你和孩子也能训练一个。
lines.en: Grid paper, a few pencils, and you can try training one with your child.

lines.zh: 刚才的加权求和，可以写成矩阵相乘。这也是今天 AI 的基础运算。
lines.en: That weighted sum can be written as matrix multiplication, one of today’s basic AI operations.

spoken.zh: 刚才的加权求和，可以写成矩阵相乘。这也是今天人工智能的基础运算。

lines.zh: 在 Lucas Academy，我们一起一点一点学。今天，关于 AI，你想学点什么？
lines.en: At Lucas Academy, we learn step by step. What do you want to learn about AI today?

spoken.zh: 在卢卡斯学院，我们一起一点一点学。今天，关于人工智能，你想学点什么？

title.zh: 1分钟了解2026诺贝尔奖：光遗传学
title.en: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Medicine in one minute: Optogenetics

lines.zh: 一分钟了解二零二六年诺贝尔奖：光遗传学。
lines.en: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Medicine, in one minute: optogenetics.

spoken.en: The twenty twenty six Nobel Prize in Medicine, in one minute: optogenetics.

lines.zh: 线索藏在绿藻里。光一照，它们就朝着光游。
lines.en: The clue starts with tiny algae. Shine a light, and they swim toward it.

lines.zh: 科学家找到了会被光打开的门。装进别的细胞，光就能让它发出信号。
lines.en: Scientists found a door that light could open. Put it in other cells, and light could trigger a signal.

lines.zh: 给失明病人的视网膜细胞，装上另一种开关，用琥珀色光打开。
lines.en: In a blind patient, a different switch made retinal cells respond to amber light.

lines.zh: 特制眼镜把明暗变化，变成一闪一闪的光点。这叫编码。
lines.en: Special glasses turn changes in brightness into pulses of light. That is encoding.

lines.zh: 大脑再学着把光信号读成东西的样子。这叫解码。
lines.en: The brain learns to read those signals as objects. That is decoding.

lines.zh: 练了几个月，他能找到一些物体，还能伸手去摸。
lines.en: After months of training, he could locate some objects and reach out to touch them.

lines.zh: 这是一位病人的部分恢复。他仍需要眼镜，也没恢复正常视力。
lines.en: This was partial recovery in one patient. He still needed the glasses, and normal vision had not returned.

lines.zh: 在 Lucas Academy，我们一起一点点探索：大脑如何思考，AI 又如何学习？
lines.en: At Lucas Academy, we explore step by step: how do brains think, and how does AI learn?

spoken.zh: 在卢卡斯学院，我们一起一点点探索：大脑如何思考，人工智能又如何学习？
